item.title: Gunman shoots 2 police officers in West Philadelphia
item.description: Two Philadelphia police officers were hurt in a shooting in West Philadelphia early Saturday morning. One officer was hit 12 times.

item.title: Putin relays Iran's position on deal to President Trump
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin played mediator between Iran and President Trump on Friday, talking to the U.S. president about what Iran wants to end the war.

item.title: Russian strikes kill 15 in Ukraine after Trump gets diesel deal with Moscow
item.description: The strikes came a day after President Trump announced a deal to buy Russian diesel that Kyiv warned would help bankroll Moscow's war in Ukraine.

item.title: Woman survives two cancers after surprising diagnosis: "I feel so lucky"
item.description: Vicky Titcomb didn't think anything was wrong. Then a routine heart scan showed an early sign of a deadly disease.

item.title: Isaias continues to weaken as it lashes Southeast with rain and flooding
item.description: Nearly 900,000 people were without power after Isaias made landfall as a hurricane on the northern Gulf coast near Destin, Florida, on Friday night.

item.title: Multiple people, including 2 children, killed in reported mass shooting in Erie
item.description: Two women were found dead in the street, two children were killed, and the victim reportedly took their own life in a mass shooting in Erie, Pa.

item.title: The Uplift: Mr. Liberty
item.description: David Beganud introduces us to a man who has been visiting prison nearly his whole life – giving him the experience he needed to help inmates and their families. Plus, more heartwarming news.

item.title: Hurricane Isaias makes landfall on Gulf Coast
item.description: Hurricane Isaias, the first Atlantic hurricane of 2026, made landfall near Destin, Florida, on the northern Gulf Coast.

item.title: Blanche, other DOJ appointees can take part in political campaigns, memo says
item.description: The Justice Department has loosened the guidelines for the attorney general and other senior ​political appointees, allowing them to participate in political activities.

item.title: Pentagon's plan to livestream execution sparks backlash
item.description: "Public executions are what oppressive dictatorships like Iran and Afghanistan do," said GOP Sen. Thom Tillis.

item.title: California high-speed rail consultants billed taxpayers for late-night rides
item.description: CBS California Investigates obtained receipts behind the watchdog's findings of wasteful spending, revealing previously undisclosed connections to the high-speed rail CEO.

item.title: When 2 dogs went missing in a car crash, a volunteer spent weeks searching
item.description: Christine Quaiff has found dozens of dogs over the last few years. She's part of a growing national network of lost pet recovery specialists who offer this service, often for free.

item.title: AI executives planning "day after" scenarios following possible catastrophic event, Axios reports
item.description: New reporting from Axios reveals that leaders at artificial intelligence companies like OpenAI and Anthropic are planning behind the scenes for fallout scenarios should a significant AI cyberattack occur. Axios tech policy reporter Maria Curi has the details.

item.title: Delta CEO says demand is still strong despite company slashing 2026 profit forecast
item.description: Delta Air Lines' stock stayed flat on Friday despite news that it will slash its 2026 profit outlook. CBS News business contributor Javier David joins with analysis.

item.title: Execution of Fort Hood gunman to be livestreamed, Pentagon says
item.description: In a stunning announcement, the Pentagon says it will livestream the military execution of the man who carried out the 2009 Fort Hood shooting. Jon Gould, dean of the School of Social Ecology at the University of California, Irvine, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Secret Service director says current threat environment is "like we've never seen before"
item.description: Norah O'Donnell shares what to expect from her upcoming conversation with Secret Service Director Sean Curran and Deputy Director Matthew Quinn. Watch the full interview on Sunday on 60 Minutes.

item.title: 3 men found guilty in murders of American, Australian surfers in Mexico
item.description: A local judge has found three men guilty of murdering two Australian brothers and their American friend in Baja California, Mexico, in April 2024.

item.title: Vance says he wouldn't watch livestream of Fort Hood shooter's execution
item.description: Vice President JD Vance cast doubt on whether the Pentagon will go ahead with livestreaming the execution of the Fort Hood shooter and said he would not tune in if it happens.

item.title: Alabama emergency management director talks Hurricane Isaias
item.description: Hurricane Isaias is hours away from making landfall along the Gulf Coast. Jeff Smitherman, director of the Alabama Emergency Management Agency, joins CBS News to discuss the preparation measures his state is taking.

item.title: Panama struck by 2 powerful earthquakes, U.S. Geological Survey says
item.description: Panama was struck by a powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake followed by a 6.6 magnitude quake later in the day.

item.title: Lost pet recovery specialist reunites 66-year-old widow with her dogs after car accident
item.description: Annie Olup was driving in heavy rain when she hit a guardrail and flipped her car, causing her two dogs to escape from the wreckage. Steve Hartman has the story of how a pet recovery specialist brought them home.

item.title: Watch: Bodycam footage shows Virginia police's heroic response to house fire as man trapped
item.description: New bodycam footage reveals the heroic efforts of police officers in Culpeper, Virginia, to rescue a man trapped inside his bedroom during a house fire. Kris Van Cleave reports.

item.title: A look at NFL legend Mike Ditka's legacy after his death at 86
item.description: Mike Ditka, an NFL Hall of Famer and Super Bowl-winning coach, died Friday at age 86. Mark Strassman has more.

item.title: Map shows ICE shootings in U.S. during immigration crackdown
item.description: Map shows details on each of the shootings carried out by DHS agents during the president's second term.

item.title: Philadelphia police say Anthropic AI submitted a "false homicide tip"
item.description: Anthropic notified the Philadelphia Police Department of the incident and later published a report describing what happened.

item.title: Cook Political Report shifts 18 more House seats in Democrats' favor ahead of midterms
item.description: A new Cook Political Report shifted 18 more House seats in democratic candidates' favor, with midterms just 25 days away. CBS News' political director Fin Gómez breaks it down.

item.title: 10/9: CBS Evening News
item.description: Hurricane Isaias to make landfall Friday; New details on NYC ICE shooting amid outrage.

item.title: Rep. Adam Smith calls Pentagon plan to stream Fort Hood shooter execution "barbaric and gratuitous"
item.description: The Pentagon has confirmed that it plans to livestream the firing squad execution of the man convicted of the 2009 Fort Hood shooting. Democratic Rep. Adam Smith of Washington, who serves on the House Armed Services Committee, joins "The Takeout" with his reaction.

item.title: These 18 million households now rank as America's richest
item.description: The smallest age group in the U.S. is also the richest, with a 37% jump in net worth over the last three years — far higher than any other group.

item.title: 10/9: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: New York City officials condemn ICE after agent shoots man; candidates clash during Senate debates in Georgia and Michigan.
